hook_text: Posts every 5 m around a 320 m field. 64 or 65 posts? It depends on one thing.
clip_script: Posts: a fence around a closed figure with posts every five metres along a perimeter of 320 metres needs 320 divided by five, sixty-four posts. For a closed loop, the number of posts equals the number of gaps; for an open, straight fence, it is one more than the number of gaps.
visual_style: An aerial sports field with fence posts popping up around the loop until the last gap meets the first post; then a straight fence with an extra post at the end.
pacing: Loop animation, closing click, straight-fence contrast.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson to find the perimeter of any polygon.
